prompt:
Use the supplied warrior concept as exact style and character identity reference. Produce a professional 2D skeletal-animation PARTS ATLAS, 4 columns by 4 rows equal cells, square canvas ideally 2048x2048. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with clean antialiased alpha. NO checkerboard drawn, NO labels, NO text, NO guides. Sixteen isolated hand-painted game sprite parts, ONE object centered in EACH cell, generous transparent gutters, no part crossing a cell. All parts from the same original adult blue-gray/copper fortress warrior, same front-left 45 degree view (head nose points toward IMAGE LEFT). Keep impeccable 2D outlined illustration, 3 tone cel shadows, burgundy cloth. This is experimental deconstructed artwork, retain original armor styling. Every joint end must have generous rounded painted overlap hidden under neighboring part, so no holes. Do not include any assembled character.
EXACT GRID LAYOUT LEFT TO RIGHT:
ROW 1: (1) complete head with hair beard neck, silver forelock, face left; (2) torso armor with burgundy neck scarf, NO arms or head or legs, shoulder sockets painted closed, waist belt; (3) pelvis with hip armor and short split ivory/burgundy skirt, NO legs; (4) rear short burgundy cape/scarf tails alone.
ROW 2: (1) anatomical left upper arm with larger decorative shoulder armor, angled vertically down; (2) anatomical right upper arm with smaller shoulder armor, vertically down; (3) left armored forearm vertically down NO hand; (4) right armored forearm vertically down NO hand.
ROW 3: (1) left leather glove hand, three-quarter curled fingers ready to close over a 12px shaft, thumb and palm clear, short wrist cuff; (2) right leather glove hand with thumb and fingers wrapped in gripping pose over an empty shaft space, short wrist cuff; (3) left thigh armor and trouser segment vertical; (4) right thigh armor trouser segment vertical.
ROW 4: (1) left lower leg shin armor and complete boot pointing image left, vertical shin; (2) right lower leg shin armor and complete boot pointing image left, vertical shin; (3) isolated HAMMER A, rectangular dark steel/copper ornate head, straight narrow brown leather handle vertical downward and pommel; (4) isolated HAMMER B, pale faceted stone head blue steel bands, identical straight handle diameter and length.
All sixteen components must have authentic painted interiors, no skeletons or simple flat shapes. Entire hammer heads, boot tips and cape edges must fit their cells. No duplicates, missing cells, backgrounds or glow. Use transparent gaps so a program can crop each cell individually.
